summary: Revised implementation plan artifact for Phase 11.2 - TikTok Login & Secure Identity Link. Incorporates critical architectural refinement: separating TikTok Auth Identity from TikTok Integration Connection. Ensures disconnection revokes integration tokens while preserving Auth Identity binding to prevent UID duplication or access loss. Adds multi-version AES-256-GCM key rotation, __Host-oauth_state cookie isolation across browser tabs, idempotent account provisioning, internal-only token refresh, and 38 OAuth test scenarios.
